newsitem.title: UK: Knightsbridge Tankers prices share offering.
newsitem.headline: Knightsbridge Tankers prices share offering.

text.p: Knightsbridge Tankers Ltd of Bermuda has priced a U.S. offering of 14 million shares at $20.0 per share with a yield of 8.875 percent, lead manager Goldman Sachs said in a statement on Friday.
ICB International will purchase an additional one million shares and 2.8 million shares will be offered internationally.
There is a 15 percent Greenshoe option.
The offering is jointly led by Lazard Capital Markets. Co-lead managers are Fearnly Fonds A/S and PaineWebber International.
Share will be listed on the NASDAQ under the symbol VLCCF. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7970
